target_customer: HR and employee experience teams at large and mid-size companies, especially outsourcing and services firms with distributed workforces
problem: Companies need one platform to deliver rewards, recognition, flexible benefits and perks to employees across many countries.
business_model: B2B SaaS plus transaction margin on rewards, gifts and benefits sold through the platform
product_category: Employee engagement, rewards and benefits platform

founders.name: Sourabh Deorah
founders.background_notes: YC page says he helped build the first version of platform search for Amazon devices. Education not stated on the pages opened.

founders.name: Smiti Bhatt Deorah
founders.background_notes: Listed as founder on YC page and in press; no background given.

investors: angel investors from the US, Middle East and Southeast Asia

technical_complexity.rationale: Mobile first platform integrating rewards catalogs, benefits and communities across 60 plus countries; mainly integration and catalog engineering rather than research.

defensibility.rationale: Corporate customers integrate payroll and HR flows, but reward catalogs and recognition features are widely offered by rivals.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or copying identified in the sources opened.

market_need_then: Entrackr reported over 370 companies across 60 countries already using it in August 2021, including Concentrix, Teleperformance, Hexaware, EY and Target, which shows paying demand from distributed workforces.

branding.domain_note: advantageclub.co at the batch; moved to advantageclub.ai after the June 2024 rebrand.

rebrands.why: Strategic repositioning as AI driven employee engagement per a June 2024 press release

brand_strength.rationale: Generic descriptive name; press is mostly funding and press release coverage.

outcome_analysis: Advantage Club is active with a large headcount and has grown revenue, with the CEO saying in December 2024 it was on track for 8 million dollars that year. It raised about 5 million dollars in 2021 and 4 million in December 2024, small totals relative to its team size, and rebranded around AI in 2024.
notes: Entrackr calls the combined 2021 raise a pre Series A of 5M; stage recorded as other for each tranche. Dec 2024 round is not labelled Series A by the Inc42 article, one aggregator calls it Series A; stage left as other. A People Matters headline mentions a 1M Series A that was not opened and an Inc42 headline from earlier mentions 4M from Axilor; these may be the same events or earlier rounds, unverified. Company site returned 503. Competition: no dated 2021 competitor source found; CB Insights lists Xoxoday, Reward Gateway and Blueboard without dates, so none recorded. Founding year 2016 per YC, CB Insights says 2014 and formerly Work Advantage (unverified). No layoffs found.
